findings.summary: The Jackson Inc trademark-clearance kickoff assigns core searching to Matthew Parrish, who is not on the matter team and has no access to the matter folder.
findings.evidence: d:0044 is addressed 'To: Kelly Snyder, Matthew Parrish' and tasks him with substantive work: 'Matthew Parrish will take the state and common-law searches so we cover more ground in parallel' and 'Matthew Parrish, start reading into the goods-and-services classes.' But engagement E-2024-001 lists only Ashley Williams and Kelly Snyder as internal participants, Matthew has no ACL grant under 'Engagements/Jackson Inc/', and he appears in no other Jackson document. The person assigned the clearance searches cannot open the matter file that assigns them.
